case.title: Password-save failure/retry
case.variant: Mismatched new-password confirmation rejected before an Auth write; server-failure and successful-retry variants remain pending
case.context: Use the existing original verified Choose a new password tab for the intended account; keep it open without refreshing or reopening the email link.
case.input_rule: Enter two different private test values, each at least eight characters, in New password and Repeat new password. Never share either value.
owner_return_fields: Whether the password form remains visible
case.stop_after_message: Leave the fields mismatched and stop after reporting; do not correct and submit matching values yet.
case.if_original_verified_tab_unavailable: Report that state without requesting another link or trying to recreate the session.
case.if_saved_or_verification_screen_appears: Stop and report the result rather than requesting a code or continuing.
case.cleanup: Keep the original recovery tab open for the next controlled step; replay/denial tabs can be closed.

source_review.auth.html: Both password fields have required and minlength=8, so each mismatched value must be at least eight characters to reach confirmation validation.
source_review.auth-security.js: createLinkController.save calls validateNewPassword before verifiedUser or auth.updateUser. password_mismatch maps to Passwords do not match.
source_review.auth-flows.js: A thrown validation error is displayed by operation; the form reset/hide and finishPasswordFlow run only after controller.save succeeds.

scope: This checks browser confirmation validation, not a provider/network save failure, password update success, retry idempotence, security invalidation or application continuation.
later_matching_save_readiness: Confirm exact controlled gateway-code recipient and bounded application-window readiness before a separate matching-password save/verification/continuation handoff. The mismatch attempt itself needs neither.
